# Ceyhun Akar

> Data engineer in Istanbul (UTC+3). I build the secure, multi-tenant analytics layer and the pipelines that feed it. Contract data engineer at Mediastream AG on ComplyGuard, a compliance analytics platform for regulated iGaming, since December 2024. Executive MBA student at Istanbul Technical University.

## Work (Mediastream AG, ComplyGuard)

- Two-layer tenant isolation on ClickHouse: a FastAPI query guard plus deploy-time row-level security policies, covered by a 57-test isolation suite.
- Most of the analytics backend (now 100+ REST endpoints over 35 tables) and its first Svelte 5 front end; an earlier version of the customer-facing app runs in production. A no-code dashboard builder behind a SQL guard.
- Airflow on Kubernetes for two data platforms; a URL-classification pipeline split into scrape, translate and predict stages; incremental Cassandra-to-ClickHouse paths with Kafka Connect and PySpark.
- A streaming path from model scores to KPIs with Kafka Connect and PyFlink into ClickHouse (retired in 2026).
- SSO with TOTP 2FA (Authelia, LLDAP), data-driven role-based access and audit logging.
- Co-built compliance workflows: the rule-authoring side of a rules engine with four-eyes approval, and license, obligation and case management.

## Stack

Work stack (paid work or a live product): Python, SQL, Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect, Apache Flink (PyFlink), Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, dbt, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Apache Cassandra, Redis, Apache Superset, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, AWS, Google Cloud, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, MLflow.
Built with (projects): Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, Amazon Bedrock, Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, MongoDB, Trino, Apache Hive, Apache NiFi, MinIO, Tableau, Confluent Cloud.

## Public projects (2024)

- [Real-time review sentiment pipeline](https://github.com/akarce/real-time-data-pipeline-kafka-mongo-elasticsearch-pyspark): Kafka, Spark, MongoDB, Elasticsearch; with an 82-minute YouTube build.
- [e2e-structured-streaming](https://github.com/akarce/e2e-structured-streaming): Airflow, Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Cassandra.
- [elk-stack-mastery](https://github.com/akarce/elk-stack-mastery): multi-node Elasticsearch, Logstash and Kibana with index lifecycle tiers.
- [RedditDataPipeline](https://github.com/akarce/RedditDataPipeline): NiFi, Airflow, MinIO, Hive, Trino, Superset.
